facts.fact: Government decree no. 2020-312 of 15 May 2020 records that the Instance nationale de protection des données à caractère personnel gave its opinion on the decree, puts the citizen-ID register under its control, lets any person lodge an objection with it, requires bodies to facilitate its inspections, and seats it on the register's oversight council.
